The '''Samarine system''' was located in<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Samarine Province]],<ref name="EAOC" /><ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref><ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023 3.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-04-12}}</ref> a [[Sector/Legends|subsector]] of the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="NewTerritories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Samarine [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
